constraints: Exact immutable business subject and acceptance predicate, with current authoritative judgment/status validity at use
No own future hash/receipt or recursively self-accepted LifecycleStatus
No invented native performance, professional standing or beneficiary acceptance
Later business mutation invalidates affected current acceptance and transitive evidence
No arbitrary forward references, stale status replay or projection-created authority
Actual competent human evaluator/owner bootstrap without recursive self-certification

proposal.kind: Design proposal from canonical author,2026-09-12; not yet committed/integrated or independently accepted
proposal.selected: Immutable business payload revisions plus intrinsic LifecycleStatus revisions and one current status head per exact business subject. State does not mutate judged business bytes. LifecycleStatus has no lifecycle/acceptance of its own.
proposal.concurrency: Jointly CAS current business head, prior lifecycle head and relevant live validity heads in the same ordered transaction. New business revision initializes status and invalidates old current acceptance; C04 reads current subject/status/dependency closure at use.
proposal.rejected_alternative: Atomic frozen complete candidate-postimage and judgment group with final independent digest endorsements; adds routine preparation/confirmation labor and brittle self/child joins. Broader mechanical migration of existing lifecycle contracts preferred, pending defensibility review.
proposal.remaining: Complete affected schema/API/storage/command/source mappings, finite actual human bootstrap, exact tests, migration version and independent conformance judgment.
